'''Carl Thompson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2002 Houston DPC]] on 14 July 2002, according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3841">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houston], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 16 July 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
